cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: All wins in the current symbol drop are collected and thereafter all symbols which were part of a winning combination explode except for the walking Wild. The remaining symbols fall vertically until they reach a resting position, an additional row is added at the top and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. The avalanche continues as long as new winning combinations appear.

base_game_loop.summary: J-POP: paid spin on 4x6. 4,096 ways to win expanding up to 262,144 ways to win. Avalanche/tumble after wins. Bonus modes: Bonus, Super Bonus. Round ends on win cap if reached.

phases.name: Place bet and spin
phases.what_happens: Player selects bet and hits Spin (or Auto Spin). Optional: activate an X-iter mode from base game only before the drop/spin.
phases.state_changes: Bet locked; optional X-iter mode selected

phases.name: Initial symbol drop/spin
phases.what_happens: Symbols land on 4x6. Game-specific setup features may fire (birds, Nitro/COOL reels, collectors, etc.).
phases.ends_when: All symbols at resting positions / reels stopped

phases.name: Evaluate wins
phases.what_happens: Evaluate wins: 4,096 ways to win expanding up to 262,144 ways to win

phases.name: Remove winners and Avalanche
phases.what_happens: All wins in the current symbol drop are collected and thereafter all symbols which were part of a winning combination explode except for the walking Wild. The remaining symbols fall vertically until they reach a resting position, an additional row is added at the top and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. The avalanche continues as long as new winning combinations appear.
phases.ends_when: No new winning combinations after a fill
phases.state_changes: Grid updated; avalanche chain may continue

phases.name: End-of-drop features
phases.what_happens: Resolve end-of-round features (bombs, mystery reveals, row swaps, boosters, etc.) if nothing else can happen; may resume avalanches.

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If bonus/super-bonus trigger conditions met, enter bonus mode after resolving same-drop features. Otherwise settle base-game wins subject to win cap.
phases.state_changes: Enter bonus mode or settle base round

modes.trigger: 3 or more bonus symbols trigger the bonus game.

rules.
A combination of three or more bonus symbols in normal mode trigger the bonus mode with free drops. Walking Wild symbols will be kept when entering the bonus game.
Bet amount and balance are always displayed in the info bar at the bottom of the game view in the currency that the player has chosen.
